name: Zero To Lend
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the REKT article excerpt.
rootCause: Over ten months ago, $371K in LBTC left ZeroLend's Base market and never came back. Neither did an explanation. The team blamed "high utilization." GitHub went quiet. Users still can't withdraw. But hey - the deposit button still works.
